_comment: Config for train_topo_group_lasso.py — four model variants are trained:
topo_only   : TopoLoss only (all sparsity lambdas zeroed automatically)
Group-lasso penalty: sum over spatial patches of mean_batch(||act_patch||_2).
Patches are defined by the same factor_h/factor_w downsampling grid used
Top-level keys can be overridden via CLI (e.g. --epochs 30 --device cuda:1).
null paths resolve to project-root defaults at runtime.
Per-layer keys must be edited here; they cannot be set from the command line.
lambda_gl      : group-lasso weight (used only for topo_gl variant).
lambda_kl      : KL-divergence weight (used only for topo_kl_ent variant).
lambda_entropy : entropy penalty weight (used only for topo_kl_ent variant).
temperature    : softmax temperature for KL/entropy computation.
Only fc1 receives TopoLoss + sparsity penalties; fc2 is left unconstrained.
